newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill, Gdansk refinery sign $100 mln loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Merrill, Gdansk refinery sign $100 mln loan deal.

text.p: The U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch and Poland's Gdansk refinery signed in London on September 3 a $100 million five-year loan agreement, the refinery said in a statement on Thursday.

The transaction, fully guaranteed by Merrill Lynch, is the first tranche of financing of the refinery's $400 million investment programme, which it will be implementing until 1999, the statement said.

"Representatives of the Gdansk refinery and Merrill Lynch are fully satisfied with the terms of the transaction and will inform about the details in a few weeks when a consortium of lenders is created," it said.
